title: How AI may be messing with home prices
raw_text:
Key Points
- Celebrity real estate CEO Ryan Serhant said ChatGPT almost blew up a $50 million deal.
- For most real estate professionals, the data aggregation capabilities of AI can enhance their expertise.
- But experts warn artificial intelligence can't match the anecdotal knowledge of a human real estate agent and might not be inclined to offer hard-to-hear advice.
